system.description:
You weave your magic into the mind of another, controlling their thoughts and dictating their every action.

Choose a thinking creature within 10 spaces. They must make an opposed Willpower check or fall under your command for 1 minute. If the creature is currently hostile to you, it has Advantage on this check.

As a Free Action, you can issue simple commands, such as "protect me," "follow them," "answer my questions," etc. The creature obeys to the best of its ability, then defends itself from harm until it receives further instructions.

Alternatively, you can use an Action to take direct control of the creature, moving it up to its speed, or using an ability it might have.

Any time the creature takes Damage or is commanded to do something that goes strongly against its character, it may make another Willpower check to try and break your control. The creature ignores any commands that would obviously cause harm to itself.

Each extra success extends the duration by +1 minutes.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.titan-vttrpg-compendium.effects.ActiveEffect.LoloxoJ4S9Yjvpdx]{Dominate Creature}
